data_ui.chart_flag_truncated_bar_axis: Bar axis does not start at zero
data_ui.chart_teach_truncated_bar_axis: Bars show size by length. If the axis starts above zero, small gaps look huge. Start bars at zero.
data_ui.chart_flag_dual_axis: Two different axes in one chart
data_ui.chart_teach_dual_axis: Two scales can make unrelated lines look linked. Use two charts, or one shared scale.
data_ui.chart_teach_too_many_categories: Past about a dozen bars nobody can read them. Group small ones or show the top few.
data_ui.chart_teach_unsorted_bars: Sorted bars let the eye rank values at once. Sort high to low unless the order means something.
data_ui.chart_teach_missing_units: A number without a unit is a riddle. Say what is measured: units, USD, percent.
data_ui.chart_teach_smoothing_hides_spikes: A moving average can erase a spike that matters, or a typo. Look at the raw line first.
data_ui.chart_teach_pie_too_many_slices: More than about five slices cannot be compared by eye. A sorted bar chart is clearer.

glossary.trust: Trust: how much Ms. Hanh believes your reports. Good, well-sourced reports raise it; wrong, over-confident ones lower it. At zero you are fired.
glossary.energy: Energy: how many verification checks you can run today. Each paid check uses 1 Energy and half an hour. Repeat checks on the same article are free.
glossary.tier_chinh_thuc: Official: central bank, regulators and statistics offices. Usually reliable, sometimes slow.
glossary.tier_bao_chi: Press: newspapers. Fairly reliable but may exaggerate.
glossary.tier_mang_xa_hoi: Social media: fast but often rumor. Verify before you rely on it.
glossary.tier_noi_bo: Insider: colleagues and tips. Early but unconfirmed.

steps.text: This is today's question. Your job: forecast the answer using the news.
Open Browser to read the news. Colored badges show how much to trust each source.
Click a news card to select it.
Open Code Pad to verify the selected article.
Press Use. Each check costs Energy (the dots) and you only get a few a day.
Pin the articles you trust. Go back to Browser and press Pin.
Open Files: today's data export lands here. Open it and look before you trust it. Exports can repeat rows or spell names in different ways.
In Sheet, clean the table with steps, for example Dedupe. Each step shows its row count and can be undone.
In Charts, build a chart from your table and press Pin chart. Mail can attach it to your report.
Open Mail to write your report.
Pick a forecast and how confident you are. The Analysis button adds your charts and findings (optional).
Press Send. You cannot edit afterwards.
